description: This file defines the TimerRegistry class, which implements the ITimerRegistry interface for managing grain timers within the Orleans runtime. It provides methods to register timers with specific callbacks and options, utilizing dependency injection for logging, timing, messaging, and silo details.

classes.name: TimerRegistry
classes.description: Implements ITimerRegistry to manage grain timers, providing registration methods for timers with specific callbacks and options.

methods.name: RegisterTimer
methods.description: Registers a timer with a callback that takes an object and returns a Task, with specified due time and period.

methods.name: RegisterGrainTimer
methods.description: Registers a grain timer with a callback that takes a grain-specific state and a CancellationToken, with options for interleaving and keep-alive.
